profile.headline: Software Engineer II at USAA
profile.summary:
Software Engineer III at USAA. Graduate of the University of Virginia with a B.A. in Computer Science. 

Strengths include strong leadership, critical thinking, and communication skills, along with proficiency in the programming languages Python, Java, and C++ and in Microsoft Office.
